params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo=Join-Path $HOME 'local-ai-workspaces\mhw-mods'
$wt=Join-Path $HOME 'HeavenBridge\verify-current-main-uia2'
git -C $repo fetch origin main --prune
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'fetch main failed'}
$sha=(git -C $repo rev-parse origin/main).Trim()
Write-Output ('REMOTE_MAIN_SHA='+$sha)
if(Test-Path $wt){git -C $repo worktree remove --force $wt 2>$null|Out-Null}
git -C $repo worktree prune
git -C $repo worktree add --detach $wt $sha
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'worktree add failed'}
try{
 $py=(Get-Command python.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
 & $py -m py_compile (Join-Path $wt 'heaven-bridge\worker.py') (Join-Path $wt 'heaven-bridge\test_worker.py') (Join-Path $wt 'heaven-bridge\tests\test_worker.py')
 if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'compile failed'}
 & $py (Join-Path $wt 'heaven-bridge\test_worker.py'); if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'primary tests failed'}
 & $py (Join-Path $wt 'heaven-bridge\tests\test_worker.py'); if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'compat tests failed'}
 foreach($p in @('bootstrap.ps1','manage.ps1','uia.ps1','install-github-runner.ps1')){
  $tokens=$null;$errors=$null
  [void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile((Join-Path $wt ('heaven-bridge\'+$p)),[ref]$tokens,[ref]$errors)
  if($errors.Count -gt 0){throw ('PowerShell parse failed '+$p+': '+(($errors|ForEach-Object{$_.Message})-join '; '))}
 }
 $formPath=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'heaven-uia-smoke-form2.ps1'
 @'
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms
$form=New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Form
$form.Text='Heaven UIA Smoke'
$form.Width=420;$form.Height=180
$input=New-Object System.Windows.Forms.TextBox
$input.Name='HeavenBridgeInput';$input.AccessibleName='Smoke Input';$input.Left=20;$input.Top=20;$input.Width=340
$button=New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Button
$button.Name='HeavenBridgeButton';$button.AccessibleName='Close Smoke';$button.Text='Close Smoke';$button.Left=20;$button.Top=65;$button.Width=120
$button.Add_Click({$form.Close()})
$form.Controls.Add($input);$form.Controls.Add($button)
[System.Windows.Forms.Application]::Run($form)
'@|Set-Content -LiteralPath $formPath -Encoding UTF8
 $smokePy=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'heaven-uia-smoke2.py'
 @'
import importlib.util, os
from pathlib import Path
wt=Path(os.environ["VERIFY_WT"]); os.environ["HEAVEN_BRIDGE_REPO"]=str(wt)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("hb_smoke",wt/"heaven-bridge"/"worker.py")
hb=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(hb)
pid=int(os.environ["SMOKE_PID"])
base={"pid":pid,"first_match":True,"wait_ms":5000,"max_nodes":120,"max_depth":6}
tree=hb.desktop_uia(base,"uia_tree"); assert tree["count"]>0,tree
found=hb.desktop_uia({**base,"selector":{"name":"Smoke Input"}},"uia_find");assert found["count"]>=1,found
setr=hb.desktop_uia({**base,"selector":{"name":"Smoke Input"},"value":"semantic-smoke","allow_relay_text":True},"uia_set_value");assert setr["set_value"],setr
button=hb.desktop_uia({**base,"selector":{"name":"Close Smoke","control_type":"Button"}},"uia_find");assert button["count"]>=1,button
inv=hb.desktop_uia({**base,"selector":{"name":"Close Smoke","control_type":"Button"}},"uia_invoke");assert inv["invoked"],inv
print("UIA_TREE_COUNT="+str(tree["count"]));print("UIA_FIND_SET_INVOKE_OK")
'@|Set-Content -LiteralPath $smokePy -Encoding UTF8
 $uiProc=Start-Process powershell.exe -PassThru -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile','-Sta','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',$formPath)
 try{
  $env:VERIFY_WT=$wt;$env:SMOKE_PID=[string]$uiProc.Id
  & $py $smokePy
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'UIA live smoke failed'}
 }finally{
  try{if(-not $uiProc.HasExited){Stop-Process -Id $uiProc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue}}catch{}
  Remove-Item $formPath,$smokePy -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
 }
 $plugin=(Get-Content -Raw (Join-Path $wt 'heaven-bridge\plugin\plugin.json')|ConvertFrom-Json).version
 Write-Output ('PLUGIN_VERSION='+$plugin)
 Write-Output 'BRIDGE_MAIN_GATE_UIA_OK'
}finally{
 git -C $repo worktree remove --force $wt 2>$null|Out-Null
 git -C $repo worktree prune
}
